doubts.claim_under_doubt: A live run pointer for this session is found by the Stop payload's session_id
doubts.disproof_attempt: Pointers are keyed by session_id or run_id; real pointers with an empty session_id exist on disk (setup ran without SHIPWRIGHT_SESSION_ID), so the guard silently never fires for those runs.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Fall back to a session-less pointer whose run id the transcript names.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: A live pointer means the run is not delivered
doubts.disproof_attempt: A merge outside deliver_pr leaves the pointer live; the hint then says push + gh pr create after the branch was deleted, steering a duplicate PR.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Ignore pointers older than 48h; soften the push hint to check gh pr list first.

doubts.disproof_attempt: The agent obeys a block with a polling tool call, which resets the futile counter, until the 40 total cap is gone.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Tell the agent in the reason to end the turn without tool calls while a named background task runs.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: SHIPWRIGHT_ITERATE_STOP_GUARD=0 is an operator kill switch
doubts.disproof_attempt: Hook processes inherit the launch environment; it cannot be set in a live session.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Document it as launch-time and name the live escape (Esc, abandoned-by-operator).

doubts.claim_under_doubt: Guard state and blocker writes cannot clobber each other
doubts.disproof_attempt: decide() writes a merged dict without a lock; a blocker recorded between its read and write is lost; an orphaned tmp file can remain.
doubts.what_would_resolve_it: Re-read the blocker before the final write; unlink the tmp in a finally.

doubts.claim_under_doubt: Only an iterate invocation changes the autonomy decision
doubts.disproof_attempt: Any Skill whose name contains 'iterate' counts as an iterate invocation.
